name: Catherine Pringle
bioAdditions: FamilySearch gives Katherine (Catherine) a birth year of 1911 and records her marriage in Luzerne Co. on 20 Jun 1936 to Daniel F. Toole (1911-1996). It places her in Wilkes-Barre in 1950 and gives 1969 as her death year (S1). Since she was born in 1911, she was presumably the youngest child, not 'about 1912'. A WWII draft card for 'Catherine Toole' is attached, which probably means she was named as the contact on her husband's card.
